title: Peace & Cotton
subtitle: Website Design and Shopify Integration
details:
I worked with owner to make Peace & Cotton a website that reflects the organic, earth-friendly nature of their products.

The design features a natural, clean aesthetic that aligns with their brand values, using soft colors and a thoughtful layout to create a calming and welcoming atmosphere. The site highlights their ability to bring creative visions to life through sustainable design, printing, and manufacturing services, with a user experience that feels as organic and thoughtful as the products they offer.
